sources.title: ESAA: Event Sourcing for Autonomous Agents in LLM-Based Software Engineering
sources.source_fact: Reports append-only events, deterministic projections, replay verification, and two software-agent case studies.
sources.substrate_inference: Event sourcing is an auditable persistence mechanism, not evidence of cognition.

sources.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
sources.source_fact: Input-dependent state-space transitions give linear sequence scaling and strong sequence-model results.
sources.substrate_inference: A selective latent compressor is optional and cannot own authoritative identity without checkpoint and interpretation evidence.

sources.title: Recurrent Independent Mechanisms
sources.version: arXiv v3 identified by source record
sources.source_fact: Sparse communication between recurrent groups can improve generalization on factor-shift tasks.
sources.substrate_inference: Modularity remains an empirical candidate because S2 already matches the historical modular system.

sources.title: Graph Networks as Learnable Physics Engines
sources.source_fact: Object-and-relation graph networks support prediction, system identification, and planning on physical systems.
sources.substrate_inference: An explicit graph is useful as a replaceable world-model projection, not necessarily the kernel.

sources.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
sources.source_fact: A learned world model, actor, and critic solve a broad suite of control tasks with a common configuration.
sources.substrate_inference: World-model value must be tested independently of persistence and identity.

sources.title: Continual Learning with Replay Processes
sources.source_fact: Rehearsal and generative replay trade current-task learning against retention.
sources.substrate_inference: Updates require quarantine, held-out improvement, retention measurement, poisoning checks, and rollback.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Experts with Expert Choice Routing
sources.source_fact: Expert-choice routing improves load balance and convergence under matched compute in reported MoE experiments.
sources.substrate_inference: Model routing is a bounded optimization policy, not a source of persistent identity.

sources.title: Agentic Memory
sources.source_fact: Exposes long- and short-term memory operations as learned policy actions on long-horizon agent benchmarks.
sources.substrate_inference: Explicit memory actions are useful contracts, but learning the policy is deferred until leakage-resistant tasks exist.

sources.title: V-JEPA 2
sources.license: official repository reports MIT and Apache-2.0 components
sources.source_fact: Reports video understanding, prediction, and bounded action-conditioned robot planning.
sources.substrate_inference: A checkpoint may become a video/world-model organ after a standalone benchmark; it cannot replace owned state.

sources.title: DINOv2 model card
sources.license: Apache-2.0 reported by official model card
sources.source_fact: Visual representations transfer to tasks including segmentation and depth estimation.
sources.substrate_inference: Image features require object, event, and decision-level tests before admission.

sources.title: SAM 2
sources.license: official repository reports Apache-2.0 for code and checkpoints
sources.source_fact: Provides promptable segmentation for images and videos.
sources.substrate_inference: Segmentation does not by itself establish object persistence or active perception.

sources.title: RAFT
sources.license: exact repository license must be rechecked before acquisition
sources.source_fact: Iterative all-pairs correlation predicts dense optical flow with strong benchmark results.
sources.substrate_inference: Optical flow is a sensor product; camera-motion separation remains a distinct mechanism.

sources.title: CoTracker
sources.license: official repository reports majority CC-BY-NC with separately licensed portions
sources.source_fact: Tracks selected or dense points jointly through video.
sources.substrate_inference: License and standalone tracking advantage must be resolved before use.

sources.title: Depth Anything V2
sources.license: Small Apache-2.0; Base/Large/Giant CC-BY-NC-4.0 per official repository
sources.source_fact: Produces robust fine-grained monocular relative depth.
sources.substrate_inference: Only the Small checkpoint is a plausible unrestricted acquisition candidate; depth alone is not 3D organization.

sources.title: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
sources.source_fact: Infers camera parameters, point maps, depth maps, and point tracks from multiple views.
sources.substrate_inference: Potential 3D organ; deferred for disk, runtime, and benchmark reasons.

sources.title: Whisper
sources.license: MIT for code and weights per official repository
sources.source_fact: A waveform-based multilingual speech model trained with large-scale weak supervision shows robust zero-shot transfer.
sources.substrate_inference: ASR can be a replaceable speech organ; transcripts cannot substitute for waveform-level evidence.

sources.title: wav2vec 2.0
sources.license: paper only; exact checkpoint license required before acquisition
sources.source_fact: Self-supervised masked latent prediction learns speech representations with limited labeled data.
sources.substrate_inference: Useful alternative speech encoder in a bounded component tournament.

sources.title: BEATs
sources.license: official unilm repository reports MIT; checkpoint terms require confirmation
sources.source_fact: Acoustic tokenizers support strong general-audio classification benchmarks.
sources.substrate_inference: General-audio recognition and cross-modal grounding require separate tests.

acquisition_decision.reason: No component had yet won a bounded standalone tournament; downloads would be decorative and the host had limited free disk.
acquisition_decision.next_gate: predeclare component task, baseline, resource ceiling, exact license, checksum, latency, memory, fallback, and Substrate-added-value test

architecture_implication.initial_candidate: small event-sourced persistent kernel with deterministic projections
